title: Raycast snippets grid
description: A centred two-tone heading over a bento of three ringed dark cards: a wide one (icon + title + sentence beside a composer-window slot that bleeds off its edge; media on top on phones) and two below, one with a search-list slot and one with three physical keycaps joined by plus signs. Hover brightens the card ring.
notes: the two window shots are media slots (token placeholders when empty)
the keycaps are built from `keys` and look best on dark themes
